title: Facebook Login
summary: Registers Facebook into the kernel sign-in shell. Credentials and the OAuth return URL live on this plugin, not kernel JSON.

blocks.title: Sign-in shell stays in the kernel
blocks.text: Session, OTP, unlock, and the HTTP routes stay kernel. This plugin owns provider credentials (settingsSchema / secrets). Disable the plugin to hide this method even if shop Preferences still list it.
Configure at Admin → Plugins → Facebook Login. Kernel identity reads via getCachedPluginSettings / getCachedPluginSecret using plugin id tuucho-signin-facebook.

Bundled path: tuucho-config/plugins/tuucho-signin-facebook/ (public config.json, gitignored config.private.json, committed config.private.example.json). Merge matches kernel JSON (common then env, private or example). Boot does not overwrite Admin values. First launch loads files once when settings are still empty. Edit in Admin → Plugins → Configure, or Update from files / Import / Export there. Admin → Plugins Update all / Import all / Export all uses the same files (schema plugins only; no extra register).

items.description: string — public. Numeric App ID from Meta for Developers. Required before Facebook Login appears on the shop.
secret — secret. App secret from Meta. Never shown after save. Type a new value only to replace it.
url — public. Must match a Valid OAuth Redirect URI in the Meta app (this shop’s /auth/facebook-return). Wrong host = Facebook error.
string — public. How long a first-time Facebook signup token stays valid (for example 10m). Raise only if customers need longer to finish.
